name: Confetti Fall Animation
author: Muhammad Shakeel

sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Plugin Directory
  2. Search for Confetti Fall Animation
  3. Install and activate
  4. Use shortcode:
    [confetti-fall-animation delay=”1″ time=”25″]
  5. Optional demo video:
    https://youtu.be/wpq-ItO53vo

sections.description:
Confetti fall animation plugin for WordPress. Add a delightful falling confetti animation to your website for celebrations and special events.

How to Use

  1. Go to WordPress Plugins
  2. Search for Confetti Fall Animation
  3. Install and activate the plugin
  4. Activate confetti on the homepage from plugin settings
    OR
    Use shortcode [confetti-fall-animation delay=”1″ time=”25″] on any post or page
  5. Enjoy the animation

Demo Video

Compatibility

Fully compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, WPBakery, and Divi.
Use shortcode on any page or post.
